model_sql.account_month_paid: with months as (select date_trunc('month', date_day) as month_start, max(date_day) as m_last from {{ ref('time_spine') }} group by 1), eligible as (select m.member_id, ms.month_start from (select distinct member_id from {{ ref('members') }}) m cross join months ms where exists (select 1 from {{ ref('cards') }} c where c.member_id = m.member_id and c.card_type in ('悦享年卡','家庭季卡') and c.valid_from <= ms.m_last and (c.valid_until is null or ms.m_last < c.valid_until) and (c.ended_at is null or ms.m_last < c.ended_at))), valid_orders as (select member_id, date_trunc('month', ordered_at) as month_start, order_id, paid_cents - refund_cents as net_cents from {{ ref('orders') }} where status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0), agg as (select member_id, month_start, count(distinct order_id) as valid_order_cnt, sum(net_cents) as net_cents_sum from valid_orders group by 1, 2) select e.member_id, e.month_start, a.valid_order_cnt, a.net_cents_sum from eligible e inner join agg a on e.member_id = a.member_id and e.month_start = a.month_start

business_model_usage.quote: 付费会员只算悦享年卡和家庭季卡的持有人；异业联名卡虽收费但由合作方经营、不进自营会员范围，体验卡不算
按自然月最后一天判断资格，先选月末有资格的账户，再统计这些账户当月全渠道、全门店的有效订单，不要求每笔订单发生当天已具备资格
账户可无卡或持多张卡，只要有一张卡在判定日有效且属本次业务范围，该账户即有资格，多张有效卡不重复算人
卡从生效日期当天起有效，到有效期结束日期当天已无效（不含结束日），有提前终止日期的从提前终止当天起无效
中途退卡、提前停卡到月底已不在有效状态则不算
